How to get it :
- Crafting table : 6 x [[gv:nugget_schrabidium_fuel|Nugget of Schrabidium Fuel]].
- Crafting table (x3) : 2 x [[gv:ingot_schrabidium_fuel|Ingot of Schrabidium Fuel]].
- Crafting table (x3) : [[gv:billet_schrabidium|Schrabidium Billet]], [[Neptunium|Neptunium Billet]], [[gv:billet_beryllium|Beryllium Billet]].
(1 more recipes: see JEI.)

Used to make :
[[gv:ingot_schrabidium_fuel|Ingot of Schrabidium Fuel]], [[gv:nugget_schrabidium_fuel|Nugget of Schrabidium Fuel]], [[gv:rbmk_fuel_mes|MES RBMK Fuel Rod]].
